title: QC the draft
body:
- `python playbook/qc.py check --platform

--account --action --text-file [--target ] [--project ] [--media ]`. - BLOCK: fix the draft and check again. ASK: answer with `--ok ="evidence"`. WARN: it can go; it is on the receipt and in the run report. - `audit.py add` refuses a reply or post without a passing receipt for the same words. - A mistake that got past QC becomes a filter (flow playbook).
